title: CIPHERMATCH: Accelerating Homomorphic Encryption-Based String Matching via Memory-Efficient Data Packing and In-Flash Processing
problem: Homomorphic encryption (HE)-based exact string matching incurs prohibitive computational latency due to expensive HE operations (multiplication, rotation) and severe data movement overhead from the large ciphertext memory footprint. Prior HE string matching algorithms cannot efficiently handle these combined bottlenecks.
motivation: Privacy-sensitive cloud applications (DNA read mapping, biometric matching, web search) require exact string matching on encrypted data, but HE's cost makes real-time deployment infeasible.
method: Homomorphic encryption lets you compute on encrypted data without decrypting it, but it's slow because multiplication and rotation operations cost a lot of computation, and the encrypted data takes up lots of memory and uses lots of bandwidth. CIPHERMATCH tackles this three ways: it packs encrypted data more efficiently to use less memory, redesigns the string matching algorithm to use cheaper addition operations instead of expensive multiplication and rotation, and moves computation close to flash storage to avoid repeatedly transferring encrypted data between storage and main memory.
key_novelty: The core idea is combining algorithm redesign to eliminate expensive multiplication with in-flash processing (computing near flash storage to avoid moving data between storage and main memory).
contributions: Optimized software data packing scheme that reduces HE ciphertext memory footprint
Algorithm reformulation eliminating expensive HE multiplications and rotations for string matching
In-flash processing (IFP) hardware architecture that performs HE-based matching near flash storage

metrics.other: not stated in abstract; paper claims latency and data movement reduction vs prior HE string matching

limitations: Specific quantitative speedup and energy numbers not available from abstract; approach is specialized to exact string matching and may not generalize to other HE workloads.
primary_theme: near-storage HE acceleration for encrypted string matching
